tools.name: archive_and_remove_object
tools.description: Moves an object to an archive bucket under the same key, overwriting any object already there, and deletes the original from the source bucket. Also tags the archived copy with an archived-at timestamp.

params.name: source_bucket
params.description: Bucket that currently holds the object

params.name: archive_bucket
params.description: Bucket to move the object into

tools.code:
import datetime

import boto3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

_s3 = boto3.client("s3")


@tool
def archive_and_remove_object(source_bucket: str, archive_bucket: str, key: str) -> str:
    stamp = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    _s3.copy_object(
        Bucket=archive_bucket,
        Key=key,
        CopySource={"Bucket": source_bucket, "Key": key},
    )
    _s3.put_object_tagging(
        Bucket=archive_bucket,
        Key=key,
        Tagging={"TagSet": [{"Key": "archived-at", "Value": stamp}]},
    )
    _s3.delete_object(Bucket=source_bucket, Key=key)
    return f"Archived {key} from {source_bucket} to {archive_bucket} at {stamp}"

tools.name: publish_manifest_to_webhook
tools.description: Writes a JSON manifest of all object keys under a prefix into the bucket and posts the manifest to a webhook URL.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket to list and write the manifest to

params.name: prefix
params.description: Key prefix to include in the manifest

tools.code:
import json

import boto3
import requests


def publish_manifest_to_webhook(bucket, prefix, webhook_url):
    s3 = boto3.client("s3")
    keys = []
    paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=prefix):
        keys.extend(o["Key"] for o in page.get("Contents", []))
    body = json.dumps({"bucket": bucket, "prefix": prefix, "keys": keys})
    s3.put_object(
        Bucket=bucket,
        Key=f"{prefix}manifest.json",
        Body=body.encode("utf-8"),
        ContentType="application/json",
    )
    with requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers.update({"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        resp = session.post(webhook_url, data=body, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
    return {"count": len(keys), "status": resp.status_code}

tools.name: move_objects_by_extension
tools.description: Finds objects under a prefix whose keys end with a given extension and moves them to a destination prefix in the same bucket. Returns the list of moved keys, or just lists the matches when dry_run is true.

params.name: dst_prefix
params.description: Prefix to move matching objects to

params.name: ext
params.description: File extension to match, such as .csv

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, only list matches without moving

tools.name: restore_archived_objects_with_fee
tools.description: Checks the storage class of each listed object, requests a restore from deep archive for those that are archived, and records the estimated retrieval cost in a local ledger. Returns the total estimated cost.

params.name: days
params.description: Days the restored copy stays available

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import boto3

_s3 = boto3.client("s3")
_RATE_PER_GB = 0.02


def restore_archived_objects_with_fee(bucket, keys, days=7):
    db = sqlite3.connect("restore_ledger.db")
    db.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS restores (bucket TEXT, key TEXT, size INTEGER, cost REAL, days INTEGER)"
    )
    total = 0.0
    done = []
    for k in keys:
        h = _s3.head_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=k)
        if h.get("StorageClass") not in ("GLACIER", "DEEP_ARCHIVE"):
            continue
        sz = h["ContentLength"]
        cost = round(sz / 1024 ** 3 * _RATE_PER_GB, 6)
        _s3.restore_object(
            Bucket=bucket,
            Key=k,
            RestoreRequest={"Days": days, "GlacierJobParameters": {"Tier": "Bulk"}},
        )
        db.execute("INSERT INTO restores VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (bucket, k, sz, cost, days))
        total += cost
        done.append(k)
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return {"restored": done, "total_cost": round(total, 6)}
